xyplot.title: Comparison grid
xyplot.hint: From the Generate form's settings, pictures that differ in one or two settings are put side by side in one table. They are drawn with the same seed, so the only difference is what you vary.
xyplot.noModels: There are no other models of the same family.
xyplot.strengthNote: Denoising strength only has an effect when generating image to image.
xyplot.error.invalid: Some values cannot be read. Check the numbers and their range.
xyplot.error.tooMany: One axis holds at most {max} values.
xyplot.problem.noAxis: Choose a setting to vary for the columns or the rows.
xyplot.problem.sameAxis: The columns and the rows cannot vary the same setting.
xyplot.summary: {columns} columns × {rows} rows = {count} pictures will be made.
xyplot.done: The grid was saved to the gallery.
xyplot.partFailed: {count} picture(s) could not be made (shown as × in the table).
